title: BNY, the world's biggest bank for safeguarding assets, plans to use blockchain tech for its transfer agency record-keeping systems that service ~$8.6T in assets (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: BNY, the world's biggest bank for safeguarding assets, plans to use blockchain tech for its transfer agency record-keeping systems that service ~$8.6T in assets — Banks rush to embrace tokenised system blurring the lines between traditional finance and digital asset ecosystem
